subject: math
description: Create a polygon portfolio reference sheet with accurate drawings, labels, classifications, angle relationships, and solved examples from the Grade 7 Quarter 1 polygon unit.
learningObjectives: Create a polygon reference sheet with drawings, labels, and solved examples
Classify polygons by number of sides, regularity, and convexity
Use interior, exterior, and adjacent angle relationships to justify measurements
Defend polygon classifications and measurements using clear mathematical reasoning
prerequisites: Define polygon, side, vertex, diagonal, regular, and irregular
Draw polygons using a ruler and protractor
Describe complementary, supplementary, vertical, adjacent, interior, and exterior angles
